assumptions.finding: Sensitivity to retail and wholesale relative price changes is a controlled simulation assumption, not an estimated causal elasticity.
assumptions.decision: Profiles 0, -0.4, -0.8, -1.2. Individual profile remains metadata, never a feature.

assumptions.finding: No approved real historical Bs/USD source.
assumptions.decision: Synthetic values and quote ages. A cost or FX change alone does not mechanically change sales if customer prices and stock stay unchanged.

assumptions.finding: Landed cost differs from original import cost.
assumptions.decision: USD cost multiplied by explicit Bs/USD plus freight and other Bs. Reject prices below cost, never silently raise prices.

assumptions.finding: Supplier and internal calendar-day times have no empirical own history.
assumptions.decision: Explicit synthetic scenarios. Arrival is not receipt. Only confirmed receipt adds sellable stock. Inspection precedes resale of returns.

assumptions.finding: UCI large orders do not certify wholesale/minor labels.
assumptions.decision: POR_MENOR and POR_MAYOR assigned explicitly by simulation, with cost <= wholesale <= retail.

assumptions.finding: No own as-of historical availability source is certified.
assumptions.decision: Generate and reconcile stock and receipts independently. Exclude quarantine and transit from opening sellable stock.

assumptions.finding: Committed orders may overlap forecast sales.
assumptions.decision: Repos uses max(forecast, commitments), not their unqualified sum. No causal confidence is implied.

assumptions.finding: Gross units cannot be made net by negative transactions.
assumptions.decision: Separate future cancellations/returns metadata. No negative target. Do not copy UCI or Favorita fractional quantities.
New release uses new synthetic worlds and future simulated calendar, with family membership confined to one split. No claim that future dates are observed sales.
Cold start, incomplete month and absent quote are explicit abstention/partial cases, not eligible training rows with invented zeros.
M5 overlapping histories not concatenated. Favorita absence not zero and no unit price. Automotive remains blocked.

assumptions.finding: Synthetic validation is technical, not commercial.
assumptions.decision: No guarantee that a price increase reduces real demand by the assumed amount. No 100% forecasting claim.

real_data_requirements: Dated price and landed-cost events with recordedAt and effectiveAt
Identified FX provider, rate kind, observation and availability times
Stock, quarantine, receipt and reservation ledger with as-of versions
Order modality, outstanding and fulfilled quantities as-of cutoff
Promotion and supplier lead-time history, not inferred from absent sales
human_decisions_remaining: Business tolerances and real-world economic validation
Joint acceptance of scenario API and new model before activation
